Trading Technologies expands institutional digital asset access through Bitstamp
summary:
Trading Technologies International, Inc. (TT), a global capital markets technology provider, and Bitstamp by Robinhood, one of the world's longest-running crypto exchanges, today announced that institutional clients can now trade Bitstamp digital asset markets through the TT® platform.
Through this connection, institutional market participants can access Bitstamp by Robinhood’s crypto spot and derivatives markets alongside other asset classes, including futures, fixed income and foreign exchange (FX) within TT’s multi-asset environment. The integration delivers institutional-grade risk controls and unified post-trade workflows to firms expanding their digital asset operations, particularly across high-growth markets in the Asia-Pacific and North America regions subject to local availability.
TT also becomes the first major traditional-markets order/execution management system (O/EMS) to connect directly to Bitstamp by Robinhood, expanding Bitstamp’s connectivity beyond predominantly crypto-native trading platforms and into established multi-asset trading workflows.
Tomo Tokuyama, EVP and Managing Director, FX at TT, said: “Institutional trading desks want to access digital assets through TT with the execution tools, connectivity, workflows and risk controls they already use across other TradFi markets. Our integration with Bitstamp by Robinhood brings crypto-native spot and perpetual futures liquidity directly into the TT workflow alongside crypto derivatives, enabling clients to manage execution across asset classes from a single, familiar environment while maintaining the execution, risk management and operational efficiencies they rely on across their broader trading operations.”
Nicola White, VP of Institutional Crypto and GM of Bitstamp by Robinhood, said: “Connecting with Trading Technologies continues our rapid expansion of institutional distribution partners. As a leading multi-asset trading platform with deep roots in traditional markets, TT extends our venue to a global network of sophisticated institutional traders, proprietary desks and buy-side firms. Market participants, through Trading Technologies, can access Bitstamp by Robinhood’s deep liquidity and institutional execution services within their primary daily workflow seamlessly.”
The two companies also plan to collaborate on joint educational initiatives and industry events to support continued institutional adoption across digital asset markets.

Paysafe Appoints Gaming Industry Veteran Rob Schonfeld as Chief Revenue Officer
summary:
Paysafe, a global payments platform built for the experience economy, today announced the appointment of Rob Schonfeld as Chief Revenue Officer (CRO). In this role, Schonfeld will lead Paysafe's global revenue organization, overseeing commercial strategy, sales execution, business development and strategic partnerships as the company continues to strengthen its position as a leading payments partner for businesses operating in the experience economy.
Schonfeld joins Paysafe with more than 25 years of leadership experience driving growth, innovation and commercial transformation across the gaming, media and entertainment industries. He will be responsible for advancing Paysafe's global growth strategy, deepening customer relationships and identifying new opportunities to expand the company's market presence across its core verticals.
Most recently, Schonfeld served as Chief Business Officer at Ludeo, where he led business development, strategic partnerships, marketing and go-to-market strategy. Prior to that, he was Global Revenue Officer at Activision Blizzard, overseeing global revenue operations, digital and physical distribution, and strategic commercial partnerships. During his tenure, he played a key leadership role in the company's digital transformation and growth, including supporting its landmark acquisition by Microsoft in 2023.
"Rob is a proven leader with a remarkable track record of driving growth and transforming global businesses," said Bruce Lowthers, CEO and Executive Director of Paysafe. "His extensive experience building high-performing commercial organizations, combined with his deep understanding of the gaming ecosystem and digital commerce, makes him an outstanding addition to our executive team."
"As payments continue to play an increasingly strategic role in digital experiences, Paysafe is exceptionally well positioned to help businesses grow and serve their customers more effectively," said Schonfeld. "The company's strong portfolio of payment solutions, leading positions in key verticals and commitment to innovation create a compelling platform for future growth. I'm excited to join the team and help accelerate Paysafe's next chapter."
Before joining Activision Blizzard in 2012, Schonfeld spent 12 years at The Walt Disney Company in senior leadership roles focused on digital content distribution, business development and commercial strategy. Earlier in his career, he held strategy and consulting positions across the media and entertainment sectors.
In addition to his executive leadership experience, Schonfeld serves as a Partner at Redstone Investments and a Board Governor of the Boys & Girls Clubs of Metro Los Angeles. He holds an MBA from the UCLA Anderson School of Management and a Bachelor's degree in Commerce from the University of British Columbia.
